reason: After thorough review of the 2024 Annual Report excerpt provided (covering Annual Review, Governance, Review by Board of Directors, and Financial Statements sections), no Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures were disclosed by Neste. The document discusses the company's production capacity (5.5 million tons annual nameplate capacity increasing to 6.8 million tons after Rotterdam expansion), market position as world's leading SAF and renewable diesel producer, and their carbon handprint target (20 MtCO2e GHG reduction by 2030), but does not provide any TAM estimates for their addressable markets in sustainable aviation fuel, renewable diesel, or other segments. The company focuses on operational metrics and sustainability targets rather than market sizing disclosures.
